provenance.encodes: EU Interinstitutional Style Guide (OJ references: OJ L <issue>, <d.m.yyyy>, p. <page>)
provenance.how_to_verify: Open the Interinstitutional Style Guide section on Official Journal references (publications-office.ec.europa.eu/code/en/en-000000.htm) and compare with EUR-Lex citations.

negative: The OJ line ran 119 trains on 4.5.2016.
OJ samples: 3 types, p. 1 shows them.

note: The EU's own style (no year before O.J., a dotted date and p.). No authority key because the issue number restarts each year and the date is not normalized.
